questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ jiějie xiànzài zěnme duì zhèngzhì wèntí rèxīnqilai le?

answers.answer_text: How is it that your older sister has become so interested and enthusiastic about political questions now?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèi méiyou shénme qíguài, tā jīnnián kāishǐ xué zhèngzhìxué le.

answers.answer_text: There's nothing strange about that, she started studying political science this year.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ zěnme bù chī le?

answers.answer_text: Why aren't you eating?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒde wèi hěn nánshòu, chībuxiàqu le.

answers.answer_text: My stomach is uncomfortable, I can't eat anymore.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nà wǒ qù gěi ni nòng diǎnr tāng lai.

answers.answer_text: I'll go get you some soup then.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒ qù zhǎo Xiǎo Lán liáo tiānr.

answers.answer_text: I'm going to go look for Xiǎo Lán to have a chat.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ bié qù le, tā yìtiān dào wǎn yònggōng, méi shíjiān péi ni liáo tiānr.

answers.answer_text: Don't go, she works hard all day long and doesn't have the time to chat with you.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wáng jiā Xiǎo Lán cónglái méiyou nánpéngyou ma?

answers.answer_text: Hasn't the Wáng family's Xiǎo Lán ever had a boyfriend?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tā cái shíjiǔsuì, mángzhe niàn shū, hái méiyou xiǎngdào zhèixiē shìr ne!

answers.answer_text: She's only nineteen years old, busy studying, and hasn't thought of these things yet!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒde xiǎo nǚér liǎngsānsuìde shíhou cháng kū, xiànzài zhǎngdà le, bú zài kū le.

answers.answer_text: My youngest daughter cried a lot when she was two or three years old, but now she has grown up and doesn't cry anymore.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zuò fùmǔde bù yīnggāi zhòng nán qīng nǚ.

answers.answer_text: Those who are parents shouldn't regard males as superior to females.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Duì. Zuò háizide yě yīnggāi xiàoshùn fùmǔ.

answers.answer_text: Right. And those who are children should show filial obedience to their parents.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ dìdi báitian zài jiā ma?

answers.answer_text: Is your younger brother at home during the day?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bú zài, nǐ děng dào wǎnshang zài dǎ diànhuà lai ba.

answers.answer_text: No, wait until the evening and then call him.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhōngguo rén cónglái bù jiǎng nánnǚ píngděng ma?

answers.answer_text: Didn't the Chinese ever stress equality between men and women?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shuōdào nánnǚ píngděng, nà shi zuìjìn jǐshíniánde xīn guānniàn.

answers.answer_text: As for equality of the sexes, that's a new concept of the last few decades.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Dà jiātíng yǒu shénme hǎo?

answers.answer_text: What's good about large families?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zěnme bù hǎo? Rén duō, zhuàn qiánde rén yě duō ma!

answers.answer_text: What could be bad about them? After all, if there are more people, there are also more people earning money!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Yàoshi suǒyǒude rén dōu xiàng nín zhèiyàng xiǎng, Zhōngguo xiànzài bù zhīdào yǒu duōshao yì rén le!

answers.answer_text: If everyone thought the way you do, who knows how many hundreds of millions of people there would be in China now!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ zhèicì huí guó kàndào nǐ lǎojiāde rén le ma?

answers.answer_text: Did you see the people in your hometown on this visit back to your country?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Kàndào le. Tāmen shēnghuóde bú cuò, wǒ lǎojiā yě biànchéng yíge hěn rènàode dìfangr le.

answers.answer_text: Yes. They're living pretty well, and my hometown has become quite a bustling place.

questions_and_answers.question_text: yǒu yòng

answers.answer_text: to be useful

questions_and_answers.question_text: hēiyè

answers.answer_text: (darkness of) night, nighttime

questions_and_answers.question_text: xīn

answers.answer_text: heart
